claims.statement: EU F-gas rules require equipment-specific records and require sellers of charged non-hermetic equipment to retain sale and certified-installer records for five years.
Poland's CRO covers operators of equipment meeting stated refrigerant thresholds, and certified firms must pass the operator information needed for CRO records.
Demand hypothesis: wholesalers will fund the handoff because it reduces blocked sales, missing installer data and downstream service disputes.

contrary_evidence: CRO and existing field-service tools already cover parts of the record workflow.
Many small installations fall below CRO thresholds even though certification duties may still apply.

economics.acquisition_route: Hypothesis: win regional wholesalers and certification/training partners that already aggregate installers
economics.founder_net_worth_path: Hypothesis: 500 branches at 1800 PLN monthly plus usage could exceed 12m PLN ARR; a defensible national record rail could support founder equity above 5m PLN in 4-6 years
economics.founder_time: 15-20 hours weekly during first integrations, then exception-led operations
economics.gross_margin_basis: Economics hypothesis: 78-90% once integrations and templates are reusable
economics.payback: Hypothesis: recover setup capital in 9-14 months with 35 branches and moderate event volume
economics.pricing: Economics hypothesis: 800-2500 PLN per branch monthly plus 5-15 PLN per equipment event
economics.retention_or_repeat: Every sale, installation, leak check, repair, gas addition and decommissioning event

fingerprint.compounding_advantage: Permissioned installed-base lineage and exception patterns make future service events faster and harder to migrate
fingerprint.customer: Polish HVAC wholesalers, certified service firms and multi-site equipment operators
fingerprint.distribution_mechanism: Embedded at wholesaler checkout and inside service-company dispatch software
fingerprint.offer_and_business_model: Certificate lookup, job evidence capture and CRO-ready handoff sold as branch SaaS plus usage fee
fingerprint.payer_and_paid_event: Wholesaler or service network pays per branch subscription and per completed equipment handoff
fingerprint.problem_trigger: A charged non-hermetic unit is sold or serviced and certificate, installer, refrigerant and leak-check evidence must remain linked

founder_fit: Adjacent to heat-pump and renewable installers accessible through the family business
Structured event data and anomaly checks fit technical strengths
risks: No suitable CRO or certificate API may be available.
Handling personal certificate data requires strict access and retention controls.
Wholesaler integration cycles may be slow.

structure.control_point: The verified handoff connecting product sale, certified installer and equipment record before commissioning
structure.critical_dependency: Lawful certificate verification and operator-authorised CRO workflow access

thesis: An HVAC-wholesaler-embedded workflow could verify the installation firm's certificate at sale, bind the equipment and refrigerant data to the work order, and hand an authorised, audit-ready record to the operator and service company for CRO and five-year recordkeeping. It would not issue certificates or file without authority. Demand and economics are hypotheses.
title: F-Gas Sale-to-Service Evidence Rail
uncertainties: Whether wholesalers or service firms capture the budget
